items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: With one of the great unsung trumpet players, Mike Lawrence... I did a few gigs with him. INTERVIEWEE: That’s right. Great cat, man.

ctx.x: Yeah, Moses, creative Moses, somehow organizing big-band stuff. Not the typical big band, but . . .
With one of the great unsung trumpet players, Mike Lawrence, who died young. I did a few gigs with him.
